spec.title: Change the VSCode extensions icon to something more relevant
spec.context: The current VSCode extension icon is a generic kanban board with columns and task cards, which doesn't clearly represent Festina Lente's identity. "Festina Lente" is a Latin phrase from Caesar Augustus meaning "make haste slowly." A Roman column/pillar icon better represents the project's connection to Roman origins and its emphasis on structured, enduring foundations.

in-scope.item: Design and create a new Roman column/pillar SVG icon for the activity bar
Replace the existing kanban-icon.svg with the new icon
Rename the icon file to festinalente-icon.svg
Update package.json to reference the new icon path

out-of-scope.item: Marketplace icon (top-level "icon" field in package.json) — deferred
Changes to in-code ThemeIcon usage (TreeView items, CodeLens, etc.)
Color or branding changes beyond the activity bar icon

requirements.requirement: The activity bar icon shall be a Roman column/pillar design representing Festina Lente's identity and connection to its Roman origins
The icon SVG shall use currentColor for all stroke and fill values to ensure compatibility with all VSCode themes (light and dark)
The icon shall be a 24x24 SVG with simple, clean lines that remain recognizable at 16x16 rendering in the activity bar
The icon file shall be named festinalente-icon.svg and placed in apps/vscode/resources/
The package.json viewsContainers.activitybar icon path shall reference the new file
The old kanban-icon.svg file shall be deleted

file.reason: New Roman column/pillar icon replacing the kanban board icon
Old generic kanban board icon no longer needed
Update activity bar icon path from kanban-icon.svg to festinalente-icon.svg

pattern.name: SVG icon format
pattern.description: 24x24 viewBox SVG using currentColor for stroke/fill, stroke-width 1.5, no hardcoded colors. Follows VSCode activity bar icon conventions.

pattern.name: Activity bar icon registration
pattern.description: Icon referenced via relative path in package.json contributes.viewsContainers.activitybar[].icon field

product.finding: The activity bar icon is the primary visual entry point for the extension sidebar. It must be identifiable among other extension icons.

engineering.finding: Activity bar icons are configured in package.json viewsContainers. Unlike in-code icons (which use ThemeIcon), activity bar requires an SVG file path.

codebase.finding: Current icon is a 24x24 SVG depicting a kanban board with 3 columns and task cards. Uses currentColor for theme compatibility.
Line 45 references resources/kanban-icon.svg for the activity bar icon. Only place this file is referenced.

pitfall.mitigation: Use currentColor for all stroke and fill values — no hardcoded hex colors (design directive C4, validation V1)
Keep design simple with few details — column silhouette must be recognizable at 16x16 pixels

constraints.constraint: SVG must use currentColor only — no hardcoded colors (design directive C4)
Icon must be readable at 16x16 pixels (VSCode activity bar minimum render size)
Must follow existing SVG conventions: 24x24 viewBox, stroke-based with stroke-width 1.5

risk.mitigation: Test icon rendering in both light and dark VSCode themes before finalizing

risks.risk: Icon may not be visually distinct enough at small sizes depending on column design complexity
